keys: eval:if(document.querySelector('#skirmish-turnModel [data-value=realtime]').disabled)throw new Error('Realtime did not reenable'); const seed=document.querySelector('#skirmish-seed');seed.value='7';seed.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); const fog=document.querySelector('#rule-fog');if(fog.checked)fog.click()

eval@setup:const s=window.realtimeSession();if(s.setup.mode!=='skirmish'||s.setup.rules.turnModel!=='realtime'||s.setup.rules.autoCoax!==false)throw new Error('Wrong local realtime runtime');window.realtimeStart=s.snapshot.tanks.map(t=>[...t.position]);if(Math.hypot(...window.realtimeStart[0].map((v,i)=>v-window.realtimeStart[1][i]))<5)throw new Error('Overlapping spawns')

eval@combat:const s=window.realtimeSession();if(!window.realtimeShots.some(e=>e.player===0))throw new Error('Human shot failed');for(const t of s.snapshot.tanks){if(Math.hypot(...t.position.map((v,i)=>v-window.realtimeStart[t.id][i]))<0.5)throw new Error('Tank did not move: '+t.id)};({tick:s.snapshot.tick,shots:window.realtimeShots,health:s.snapshot.tanks.map(t=>t.health)})
